subject: accounting
objective: Break-even where expected volume sits exactly on the break-even point
instruction: A subscription service in a mid-sized city charges 45 USD a month per subscription. Serving one subscription costs 15 USD a month, and the fixed costs of the month are 3600 USD. The business expects to sign exactly 120 subscriptions this month. Required: report the break-even quantity, the contribution margin per subscription, the expected revenue at the expected volume, the margin of safety in units and the margin of safety as a percentage of expected volume, and the revenue at the break-even point.
